# 2026-09-11 — Pilot Kickoff

> Status: reviewed. Participants: Maya, Jo, Eli. Evidence: [posted desk notice](../sources/desk-rules.txt).

## Observations

The notice says a loan is due seven calendar days after checkout. Volunteers have been writing due dates on slips, but no common reminder message exists. We will record exceptions without making up policy at the counter.

## Decisions

Keep the seven-day term for the single-desk pilot. This became [D-01](../decisions.md#decision-log); it does not approve a reminder or extension.

## Actions

Jo will sample slips; Maya will ask what timing would make a reminder useful. Start daily notes in the [journal](../journal/README.md).
